title: Jerry Maguire
tagline: One client, one goldfish, one big dinner.
about: A sports agent loses everything after writing a mission statement and starts again with one client and one loyal colleague.

    StartersLaurel's caramelised onion dip with chipsSlow-cooked onion, sour cream and cream cheese dip with kettle chipsHow to make it3 brown onions30g butter1 tsp balsamic vinegar250g sour cream100g cream cheeseWorcestershire sauce, to taste1 bunch chives200g kettle chips3 celery sticksSlowly cook the thinly sliced onions in the butter and the oil over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep brown.Add the balsamic and cool.Chop roughly and mix with the sour cream, the soft cream cheese, the Worcestershire, the chives, salt and pepper.Chill 1 hour.Serve with the salted kettle chips and celery sticks.Rod's Arizona street cornGrilled corn with mayo, crumbled feta and chilliHow to make it4 corn cobs4 tbsp mayonnaise80g feta1 tsp chilli powder1 limeGrill the corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots.Brush each with mayonnaise, roll in the crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder.Squeeze over lime to serve.MainsRod's carne asadaLime and orange marinated skirt steak with warm tortillas and salsaHow to make it800g skirt steak2 limes1 orange1 garlic bulb8 flour tortillas250g salsaMarinate the skirt steak for 2 hours in the juice of the limes and the orange, the crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt.Grill hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin across the grain.Serve with the warm flour tortillas and the salsa.Tidwell family chicken mole enchiladasDinner at home with the Tidwell familyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Shredded chicken rolled in corn tortillas, smothered in a smoky chilli and dark chocolate mole sauce and cheese, baked bubbling, with pickled onion and crema.Soak 3 dried ancho chillies in boiling water 15 minutes.Blend with 400g tinned tomatoes, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon, 30g dark chocolate and 300ml stock, then simmer 15 minutes.Mix 600g shredded roast chicken with a third of the sauce.Fill and roll 8 corn tortillas, lay in a dish, cover with the rest of the sauce and 150g grated cheese.Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.Top with pickled red onion, sour cream and coriander.SweetsJerry and Dorothy's wedding cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with piped buttercreamHow to make it250g butter125g caster sugar2 eggs1 tsp vanilla extract150g self-raising flour60ml milk250g icing sugarBeat the butter with the sugar, add the eggs and the vanilla, then fold in the self-raising flour and the milk.Bake in the cases at 175°C for 18 minutes.Beat the butter with the icing sugar and pipe on top.DrinksTidwell's Kwan prickly pear margaritaTequila and prickly pear. The Kwan is love, respect, community.How to make it6 prickly pears180ml tequila5 limes60ml agave syrupchilli powder, to taste2 cups ice1 tbsp saltPeel the prickly pears (or use the prickly pear purée), blend and strain out the seeds.Mix the salt with a little chilli powder, wet the rims of the glasses with lime and dip.For each drink, shake the tequila, the purée, the lime juice and the agave syrup hard with ice.Strain over fresh ice.For non-drinkers, skip the tequila and top with soda water.
